<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def find_player(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if r1-r0>=4 and c1-c0>=4: return (r0-8)//6,(c0-13)//6
print("start:",find_player(current_frame))
action(['LEFT','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN','DOWN'])
print("after LEFT+DOWNx4 (expect (4,0)):",find_player(current_frame))
action(['DOWN'])
print("after DOWN (cross red (5,0)?):",find_player(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
